title: Chicken Stir-Fry
author: Claude
description: Fast wok-fried chicken with crisp broccoli and peppers in a glossy soy-sesame sauce.
steps: Sear sliced chicken in sesame oil until golden, then set aside.
Stir-fry the broccoli, pepper, and garlic until crisp-tender.
Return the chicken, add soy sauce, toss, and serve over rice.
